hints.title: Target Element Value
hints.text: The array elements are 2 * i + 1. The average and optimal target value for all elements is n.

hints.title: Symmetric Operation Pairs
hints.text: Each operation increments one element below target and decrements one element above target by 1.

hints.title: Sum of Displacements
hints.text: Sum target - (2 * i + 1) for all i where 2 * i + 1 < n. This closed-form sum simplifies to n * n // 4.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Looping through elements takes O(N) when O(1) arithmetic directly answers the query.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate derives the closed-form displacement sum n * n // 4.
complexity.notes: Works uniformly for both even and odd n.
